test_title: PYST 61: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

_DRG_ZDR_BZD_GBZ_RGB
solution:
Given series: _DRG_ZDR_BZD_GBZ_RGB

Option 1) ZBDRD → __Z__DRG__B__ZDR__G__BZD__R__GBZ__D__RGB → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) BBGRD → __Z__DRG__B__ZDR__G__BZD__R__GBZ__D__RGB → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) ZBGRB → __Z__DRG__B__ZDR__G__BZD__R__GBZ__D__RGB → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) ZBGRD → __**Z**__DRG__**B**__ZDR__**G**__BZD__**R**__GBZ**__D__**RGB → (It follows the pattern of: ZDRGB - ZDRGB - ZDRGB - ZDRGB)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
